Coram : M.R. SHAH*, C.T. RAVIKUMAR
Service Law – Entitlement to Nursing allowance – Respondents were working as Nursing Assistants in BSF and were paid “Hospital Patient care Allowance” – Respondents claimed to be entitled to “Nursing Allowance” at par with Staff Nurses – Single Judge & Nursing Assistants, thus respondents are entitled to Nursing allowance – It also held that educational qualification cannot be a ground for denial of Nursing Allowance – Division Bench of the High Court dismissed the appeal preferred by the appellant-Union of India –
Decision Date : 16-01-2023 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 172/2023 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
